tradeoff: A viewer who opts in lets Apple or Google learn that something new is waiting, and when.
entry: New-episode notifications may pass through Apple's and Google's notification services: opt-in and off by default, carrying no title, no detail and nothing about what the viewer watches; the app fetches details from the operator's server. PRODUCT.md's 'nothing is sent outside the operator's servers' now names this one exception exactly.
